scripts.dev:api: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}))" && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev src/api/index.ts --port 8787
scripts.deploy: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply microsaas-db --remote && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy src/api/index.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply microsaas-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply microsaas-db --remote
